subject: Size consultation for evening gown
message: I am 5'8" and usually wear EU 36. Should I order size S or XS in the Silk Charmeuse Gown?

responses.message: Dear Ayesha, the Silk Charmeuse Gown is cut on the bias and offers a fluid, forgiving drape. For 5'8" and EU 36, size S will ensure the exact puddle train length shown in our campaign imagery without pulling across the hip.

subject: White glove delivery window
message: Can I arrange for evening delivery between 6 PM - 8 PM in Mumbai for my order?

responses.message: Good morning Devika. Your courier dispatch has been coordinated with our luxury courier partner for an evening appointment between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM at your Bandra residence.
